description: A 40-lesson, teacher-delivered elementary classroom curriculum developed and studied by the Metropolitan Area Child Study Research Group to address social cognition and aggression risk through self-efficacy, perspective taking, normative beliefs, social problem solving, and behavioral scripts.
title: Yes I Can social–cognitive classroom curriculum
